definitions.full: H2453. Chakmoni חַכְמוֺנִי proper name, masculine ( wise ) — 1 father of one of David's warriors 1Chr 11:11 . 2 father of the tutor of David's sons 1Chr 27:32 .

occurrences.englishText: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.
